corpus_provenance.corpus_scope: The fastapi/ package directory only. Tests (593 files), docs_src/ and scripts/ are deliberately excluded from the retrieval corpus.
corpus_provenance.why_scoped: Indexing the full repo root would add 593 test files and ~500 docs_src example files, which would (a) dominate the corpus with non-library code and (b) turn fastapi/__init__.py into an extreme import hub, flattening graph corroboration. Scoping is applied identically to both the vector_only and hybrid systems, so it cannot bias the comparison.
corpus_provenance.why_copied_rather_than_pointing_at_the_p: CodeGraphBuilder resolves an absolute import such as 'fastapi.routing' by matching it against relative file paths. Scanning .../fastapi/fastapi directly would yield file IDs like 'routing.py' with module names like 'routing', so FastAPI's absolute self-imports would not resolve and almost no IMPORTS edges would be created. Copying the package so the corpus root CONTAINS fastapi/ preserves file IDs of the form 'fastapi/routing.py', which resolve correctly.
